simple.meaning: כַּפְתֹּר (kaphtôr) is a Hebrew word meaning “a chaplet ; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of a column, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כַּפְתֹּר (H3730) appears 18 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 25:31, with occurrences in Exodus, Amos, Zephaniah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּפְתֹּר (H3730) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כַּפְתֹּר (H3730) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כַּפְתֹּר (kaphtôr) / H3730 is traced through Exodus 25:31, Exodus 25:33, Exodus 25:34, Exodus 25:35 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3730. kaphtor I. כַּפְתֹּר כַּפְתּוֺר noun masculine 1 capital , 2 knob, bulb ( 2 perhaps earlier meaning; Hoffm ZAW iii. (1883), 124 , compare Syriac pear (Löw No. 153 ), from shape); — 1 כַּפְתּוֺר Amos 9:1 capital of pillar; so plural suffix כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ Zeph 2:14 . 2 כַּפְתֹּר , knob or bulb, ornament on the golden lamp-stand in tabernacle; ᵐ5 σφαιρωτήρ , Jos Archaeology iii, 6, 7 ρὁΐσκος small pomegranate ; ᵑ9 . sphaerula: — Exod 25:33 (twice in verse); 25:35 (3 t. in verse) = 37:19 (twice in verse); 37:21 (3 t. in verse); suffix כַּפְתֹּרֶיהָ 25:31 , 34 = 37:17 , 20 , כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶם 25:36 = 37:22 (all P).
definitions.rootNote: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר ; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle ;
